mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the curved line and adjusting the trim made the connection between unequal wheel speeds and steering concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the lever twice before it became available was repetitive; the needed intermediate test was not clear to me.

surprise.text: I was surprised that a small difference in motor speed made the rover draw a curve when asked to go straight.

arbitrary.text: The lever could only be fitted after the straight-line test; I understood the sequence once it worked, but not why fitting it earlier was unavailable.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the hands-on tests made the rover's steering understandable, and I would be curious to see what it does with the invitation.
